thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: metering.kvcache.prefetch_stall detected in eu1. Token-count aggregation lag > 5m, delayed emits and spike in overage flags. Severity: P2. Runbook: metering-prefetch-stall.md · @jordan_oncall please investigate · link: https://ops/redwood/incidents/4945

alex: acked. hitting logs now, grabbing tracing for emitter-consumer. seeing consumer commit lag ~120k msgs.

jordan_oncall: I'm on it. checking consumer group and broker lags. if consumer stuck we may be double-counting later.
maria_billing: customer signals: a few overage flags already triggered in the last 10m for 3 mid-market accounts. need to contain customer-visible charges.
sre_lead: quick mitigation idea: silence overage alerting and hold billing emitter while we triage. can we pause prefetching to let backfill catch up? pros/cons?
jordan_oncall: pausing prefetch flag now -> toggling `kvcache.prefetch.enabled=false` in staging then prod if stable. also starting a soft restart of emitter-consumer (rolling).
alex: logs show `ConsumeLoop: Fetch timeout, prefetched_keys=0` then `CommitError: offset out of range` - probable consumer stuck on a stale partition. running `./ops/kafka/consumer-restart.sh emitter-consumer eu1` now.

support_elaine: I'm drafting a short customer note: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting; no immediate invoice changes will be applied while we investigate." Want approval before sending.
maria_billing: please hold off on blanket refunds. first confirm whether delayed emits will retroactively reconcile counts; if they do, customers won't be charged extra. I'll coordinate ledger hold.
jordan_oncall: consumer restarted, lag dropping from 120k -> 30k in the last 2m. prefetch toggled off in prod at 4945671260. starting backfill worker at 4945671272.
sre_lead: good. keep prefetch off until backfill completes and latency stabilizes. set throttles to limit emitter throughput to protect the aggregator.
alex: adding trace snippet: ```
# quick diagnostic
curl -s http://emitter-eu1/metrics | grep consumer_lag
consumer_lag{topic="token-emits",instance="emitter-3"} 31234
```

support_elaine: customer note approved, sending to affected accounts now. tagged legal for visibility. :thumbsup:
maria_billing: I've placed affected accounts in billing-hold group; overage flags suppressed for those accounts until manual reconciliation. Leaving audit note.
jordan_oncall: last check: lag ~2k, backfill processing at 400rps. I'll keep monitoring for another 30m and then flip prefetch back on in canary.
sre_lead: plan: 1) monitor 30m 2) re-enable prefetch in single canary 3) if stable, roll 20% -> 50% -> 100% 4) run a reconciliation job to verify counts and correct any overflagged customers. create postmortem ticket.
alex: filing RT ticket: INC-494567-prefetch-stall for postmortem and action items. assigning to eng-ml and metering.

incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigations applied. status: degraded -> recovering. next update in 15m or on request.

support_elaine: outbound comms sent. monitoring for customer replies.
maria_billing: I'll coordinate any billing adjustments after reconciliation. thanks team.
jordan_oncall: will handoff to night oncall in 45m if stable. handing off logs & runbook link in the ticket.
